prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 single panel from a lurid 1950s pulp horror comic book, printed on cheap yellowed newsprint with coarse halftone dots, thick brush inking and off-register flat colour in acid green, bruise purple and blood orange. A tiny corner shop interior seen from a low dramatic angle: the shelves warp upward like a cathedral, the overhead light swings, long green shadows stretch across the floor toward a loaf of plain white bread on the counter. Its price tag reads "£5" in big hand-lettered comic type, a smaller scrawled "£1" struck through above it. A caption box in the corner, in yellow, reads "THE NEXT DAY...". The shadows behind the counter curl like fingers with no hand attached. Thanks.
